title: The scent of Halla
short_description: Citrus Experience Center

A theme park with Korean children’s favorites, Pororo and Tayo,
with a variety of attractions outside and inside, allowing visitors to have fun even on rainy days

title: Jeju Arts Center
short_description: Opened in May 2010, Jeju Arts Center is a professional performance hall with the largest auditorium in Jeju Island and fully equipped to perfectly support performances of various genres.

title: Jeju Sunshine Farm
short_description: A tangerine farm that cultivates organic tangerines with warm sunlight and care near famous attractions such as Jeju's World Natural Heritage Site, Geomun Oreum, Ramsar Wetland Site, Dongbaekdongsan, and Hamdeok Seoubong Beach.

title: Biyangdo Yeonpyeong-ri Campsite

title: Jeju Future Education Research Institute Science Exploration Experience Center
short_description: The Jeju Future Education Research Institute's Science Exploration Experience Center is located in the middle of Sanrokbuk-ro, overlooking Hallasan Mountain. As you drive along Hallasan Mountain, you'll soon arrive at the Science Exploration Experience Center. The center boasts a wealth of facilities that both children and adults will find fascinating.

title: Dreamland Children's Library
short_description: The Kumbadang Children's Library was originally a local space where presidents stayed during their visits to Jeju Island. Since its establishment in 1984, it has been used on eleven occasions by former presidents Chun Doo-hwan, Roh Tae-woo, and Kim Young-sam. After being removed from security in 1996, it was also briefly used as the official residence of the Jeju Governor. Returned to the residents of Jeju in 2014, the building, after much discussion, was renovated into the Kumbadang Children's Library in 2017.

title: Ranch Cafe Drukumda
short_description: Boasting panoramic views, Ranch Cafe Deurkumda offers a wealth of activities, including animal feeding, horseback riding, go-karts, and unique bicycle rides. Located on Beonyeong-ro Boulevard, it's easy to find, and the comfortable cafe and experience center are conveniently located in one space. Beyond the cafe's observation windows, lush green fields unfold before your eyes.

title: Sunrise Land Art Center
short_description: Ilchul Land Art Center is a specialized space for experiencing indigo dyeing. What makes this indigo dyeing experience so special is the indigo plant itself, cultivated directly. The indigo plant is sown from seeds in March or April and harvested in July or August. Once the plant reaches 60-70cm in height, it is fermented by hand to create the dye. Indigo not only boasts beautiful colors but also possesses strong antibacterial and sterilizing properties, making it a popular dye for precious clothing and documents since ancient times. Natural dyeing can be laborious, but the more effort you put into it, the richer and deeper the color.

title: Seogwipo Agricultural Technology Center Jeju Agricultural Ecology Center
short_description: Located in the central mountainous region of Seogwipo, the Jeju Agricultural Ecology Center at the Seogwipo Agricultural Technology Center is the place to find answers to all your questions about citrus fruits. Its expansive grounds include a Jeju Citrus Promotion Center, a Citrus Variety Exhibition Hall, a Citrus Forest Trail, and a citrus picking experience center.

title: Jeju Arirang NEW Soul
short_description: As an official invitation to the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics, you can enjoy the exciting Jeju Arirang, the fantastic Taekwondo musical, Dudream, and Korean dance.

title: Aewol Scuba Diving School
short_description: Aewol Scuba Diving Experience, Training from Beginner Certification to Advanced Courses

title: Jejudo Gongbang Nokkome

title: Papa Ville
short_description: Papa Ville is located in a volcanic forest and has a remarkable healing trail that runs through this rocky, yet verdant, area of the island.

title: Gwaneumsa Campground
short_description: Hallasan Gwaneumsa Campground is located in Ara-dong, north of Jeju City, and is a place where you can enjoy camping near downtown Jeju City.

title: Mulmoe Healing Farm
short_description: Mulmoe Healing Farm is located in Susan-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju-si, and its name comes from the local name Susan (water, mountain).

title: Chuidasun Resort
short_description: A meditation resort that prioritizes relaxation

title: Fantasy Forest Gotjawal Damang Foot Bath
short_description: Damang Foot Bath is located in the ‘Hwansang Forest Gotjawal Park’ where you can see Jeju’s natural primeval forest.

title: Arboretum Theme Park (Night Market Street & LED Park) - Scheduled to reopen on March 1, 2026
short_description: The night market held in the pine forest of the Arboretum Theme Park has a completely different atmosphere from other night markets. LED lights illuminate the forest, and food trucks, flea markets, and photo zones are filled with charming content.

title: Clothes ghost theme town
short_description: Otguima Theme Town is a place where you can enjoy a fun horseback riding experience in the clean and pure cypress and zelkova forests and green meadows of Uigwiri.

title: Shinpung-ri field wall road
short_description: Seongsan-eup Sinpung-ri is a half-farming, half-fishing village with the meaning of 'aiming for a new and prosperous village', and is known as the 'Eomeong-abang (mother, father) feast village' where traditional culture and lifestyle are still alive today.

title: Bukchon-ri 4.3-gil
short_description: Bukchon-ri is a seaside village located at the eastern end of Jochon-myeon.

title: Mulleung Bicycle Road (3rd section of the Ring Bicycle Road)
short_description: The three sections of the fantastic bicycle path that stretch from Haegeoreum Village Park to Songaksan Mountain are a course where you can encounter and enjoy the various beauties of Jeju, including Panpo Port, the hottest place among Jeju's small fishing ports; Sinchang Windmill Coastal Road, which adds beauty to the coastal road with offshore windmills; Suwolbong Peak and Chagwido Island, Jeju's representative sunset spots; Daejeong Oil Market, where you can enjoy the pleasure of meeting people; and Songaksan Mountain, where you can enjoy the quiet leisure.

title: Archaeological Site in Gosan-ri
short_description: Designated Historic Site No. 412, it was considered to be invaluable in the study of Neolithic cultures both on Jeju, on mainland Korea, and in Northeast Asia

title: Jeju Submarine (International Leaders Club)
short_description: International Leaders Club, a marine sports theme park where you can enjoy the emerald sea of Jeju!

title: Picnic Mate
short_description: A specialty store for picnic set rentals and picnic supplies sales

title: Barut Spa
short_description: People often stand before the rising sun, making wishes or renewing their resolve for the future. Conversely, gazing at a crimson sunset allows them to let go of the tensions of everyday life and become absorbed in the atmosphere. The coastal road in front of Sinyeom Port in Sinyeom-ri, Aewol-eup, Jeju City, is one of the best spots for a sunset drive. Here, a cozy space offers a respite for those weary of daily life. Named after the Jeju dialect word for sea, "Barut," Barut Spa is located within the Olle Resort complex, overlooking the coastal road and the Aewol Sea beyond a small forest. The spa exudes a cozy atmosphere.

title: Seam Farm
short_description: Under the azure sky, I hung a handmade indigo handkerchief in a tangerine orchard. My friend dried a small pouch made with persimmon juice. There's a place where you can experience tangerine picking in a traditional tangerine orchard and create your own unique piece through traditional persimmon juice dyeing. This is the "Ieumsae" educational farm, a natural dyeing experience center located in Wimi-ri, Namwon-eup, Seogwipo-si, that utilizes Jeju's natural dyeing techniques.

title: Workshop: Haru_and_a_half
short_description: A space where you can experience various crafts located in Woljeong-ri

title: Lotte Hotel Voice Spa
short_description: Lotte Hotel Jeju, located in Seogwipo Jungmun Tourist Complex, is renowned for its premium resort facilities. Located on the first floor of the annex, V Spa is a high-end spa specializing in Valmont, a premium Swiss anti-aging brand renowned since 1905, and Thalgo, the leader in thalassotherapy and France's No. 1 marine cosmetics brand. The spa offers a variety of programs and personalized services, delivered with the delicate touch of professionally trained therapists. These services, along with personalized services tailored to each client, help restore balance to body and mind, whether tired from travel or overwork.

title: Sweet Hotel Aroma
short_description: Sweet Hotel Aroma offers care services to warm and soothe tired legs and bodies after a cold winter trip. Located in the Jungmun Tourist Complex, Sweet Hotel Aroma is easily accessible. Located within the Jungmun Tourist Complex, it's close to hotels like the Lotte Hotel, the Shilla Hotel, and the Hyatt. Despite this, it offers the most affordable rates compared to therapies offered at luxury hotels, and its care services, backed by years of experience, make it a popular aromatherapy shop among younger customers.

title: Jeju Leisure Village
short_description: Located in Waheul, Jochon-eup, east of Jeju City, Jeju Leisure Village is a fascinating experiential village where visitors can discover their own unique ways of resting and playing through leisure analysis and personalized experience programs. "Waheul-ri," the rural village where Jeju Leisure Village headquarters is located, preserves the tradition and diversity of Jeju Batdam, a Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System (GIAHS), and serves as a hub for Jeju City's project to build a healing platform utilizing traditional batdams.

title: Marado Island Tour
short_description: Korea’s southernmost island of Marado has a tour program where residents become guides and commentators. They explain the nature, culture, history, and life history of Marado Island to its visitors, from the time it was uninhabited to the present day.

title: Jilgraengi Center
short_description: The Sehwa Village Cooperative, formed by 477 residents of Sehwa-ri, Gujwa-eup, has opened the Jilgeuraengi Center on the scenic Sehwa-ri beach. The four-story center houses the Sehwa-ri Office and a tourist information center on the first floor. The second floor houses a café and a local shop. The third floor houses a shared office space and seminar rooms, which are available for rent. The fourth floor houses the Sehwabakgeori (lodging) area.

title: Kim Tek Hwa Museum
short_description: The Kim Tek Hwa Museum in Jeju

title: Dochidol Ranch
short_description: Jeju’s only alpaca ranch in the forests of Aewol

title: Snoopy Garden
short_description: Snoopy Garden is a very special place where you can meet the beloved characters from the Peanuts comic strip. Enjoy their unique message of empathy and healing while befriending them here on Jeju Island.

title: Saebyeol Friends(Saebyeol Heyyo Farm)
short_description: Located near Saebyeol Oreum Volcanic Cone, Saebyeol Heyyo Farm is a place where you can meet alpaca, horses, donkeys, goats, sheep, and other animal friends. Create fun memories with these adorable animals!

title: Arte Museum

title: Yuland Dive Center
short_description: Seogwipo scuba diving experience, tour, and education specialist

title: Jeju Safety Experience Center
short_description: In this special experience space, where current firefighters, equipped with the skills to respond to various disasters, provide safety training, you can learn how to act independently and spend a meaningful time reflecting on the importance of safety.

title: M1971 Yacht Tour
short_description: Yacht tour with Jeju dolphins

title: Gopoit Dive Center
short_description: Gopoit Dive Center is a specialized scuba diving training center that pursues safety and enjoyment through a systematic training system based on the PADI Association.

title: Sunset Coast 1014
short_description: Experience the Suwolbong Geotrail with Jeju Electric Bikes

title: Hayoung Olle
short_description: A walking course that allows you to fully experience the charm of Seogwipo City’s original downtown. Jointly developed and operated by Jeju Tourism Organization, Seogwipo City, and Jeju Olle, Hayoung Olle, as derived from the word ‘Hayoung’,  is a place where abundant tourism resources around the original city center of Seogwipo, six urban parks (Geolmae Ecological Park, Chilsimni City Park, Saeseom Island, Jaguri Park, Jeongmosi Park, and Sombancheon), and three specialized streets (Lee Jung-seop Street, Chilsimni Food Specialty Street, and Arangjoeul Street) are fused, and it consists of a way that can be enjoyed in various ways by both tourists and residents who can enjoy the nature, humanities, and culture of Seogwipo.

title: Sinheung-ri Camellia & Juniper Road
short_description: A tree belt that becomes particularly photogenic

title: Namwon Port
short_description: Namwon Port is well-known as the starting point of Jeju Olle Walking Trail No. 5. The inner port is more or less original and is thus very special and attractive. Namwon Port is centrally located in Namwon-eup so your dining experience will consist of a wide range of options, especially fresh seafood.

title: Maheuni Forest Path
short_description: Maheuni Oreum is a horseshoe-shaped crater located in Suman-ri Village, Namwon-eup. It has an elevation of 552m and a height of 47m. Maheuni Oreum is also known as Maani Oreum and Mahani Oreum.

title: Citrus Museum Wollabong Promenade
short_description: The Seogwipo Citrus Museum is a great place to visit when it's raining or when you are looking for an educational and fun place to try with your family. All year round you can see mandarins hanging from the trees and in spring the citrus flowers bloom and the whole museum is filled with a sweet, delicious scent

title: Seojungcheon Trail
short_description: This is a place where the sound of fallen leaves crunching underfoot and the sound of water flowing along the Seojungcheon Stream are delightful. In spring, it's a beautiful place with cherry blossoms, in summer, cool waters, in autumn, red leaves, and in winter, snowy scenery. Take a leisurely stroll along the Seojungcheon Stream. You might discover a hidden gem that others haven't discovered.

title: Upoto Cinema Gallery Cafe
short_description: A cinema gallery cafe opened by photographer Woo Myung-ryul, who has been leading the Korean film photography industry, upon returning to his hometown of Jeju.

title: Kim Han Art Museum & Cafe 3206
short_description: An art gallery and cafe displaying the works and relics of Kim Han (1928-2013), a Western-style painter from North Hamgyong Province.

title: RJ
short_description: Hello, this is RJ, the developer and operator of Jeju Island village experiences.

title: Nohyung Supermarket
short_description: Perhaps a bit whimsical, yet joyful: step into this mysterious Supermarket and discover a whole new world inside.

title: Yeongdeung Halmang Mythical Park
short_description: Yeongdeung Halmang Myth Park stretches approximately 1km along a narrow, basalt stone path that runs along the coast from Gwideok Port. Stroll along the path and learn about Jeju mythology.

title: Kim Man-il Memorial Hall
short_description: It opened in August 2021 as a space to commemorate Kim Man-il (1550-1632), who contributed to overcoming national crisis by donating 500 horses for use in the war during the Imjin War.

title: Jeju Eoullim Citrus Experience Farm (Jeju Oklim)
short_description: A single-scale, wide-open field tangerine picking experience farm located in Seongsan-eup, Seogwipo-si

title: Nakcheon Ahopgut Village Chair Park
short_description: Nakcheon Ahhopgut Chair Park, with its thousand chairs, is located along Olle Trail Course 13 and is a popular stop. An observation deck with elevator has been opened, offering breathtaking views. We introduce Nakcheon-ri Chair Park, also known as Ahhopgut Village for its nine springs.

title: Seoyoung Ari Oreum / Yongwai Oreum
short_description: Yeonga-ri Oreum, meaning "sacred mountain," is also known as Seoyeong-ari Oreum (Seoyeong-ari Oreum) or Yongwai Oreum (Yongwai Oreum), due to its location in the west. Climbing the peak, the two rocks and the backdrop of Hallasan Mountain are breathtaking, even just looking at the ocean is enough to make you enchanted.

title: Wollabong Jinji Cave (Andeok-myeon)
short_description: Andeok-myeon's Wollabong peak is named for its shape, which resembles a rising moon. It's also called Darae Oreum because of the abundance of wild walnut trees growing there. To the south is Baksugijeong, and to the north is Andeok Valley. Descending from the summit, you'll encounter Jinji Cave. Wollabong has seven caves. A visit to the Jinji Cave offers a brief reminiscence on its painful history.

title: Jongdal Gomangnandol Shelter
short_description: When you travel along the Jongdal Coastal Road and reach Hado Beach, you will find the Gomangnandol Shelter. This relatively hidden spot is easy to miss if you’re driving quickly.

title: Goh's house
short_description: This building was built by Go Yong-jun. Technically, it was built with reference to Japanese architecture, but functionally, it is a transitional building that inherited the traditional content of Jeju folk houses.

title: Jeju Central Cathedral
short_description: This is the first parish in the Jeju Diocese and a Gothic-style cathedral established in 1899 by Bishop Mutel, the 8th Bishop of the Joseon Diocese, when he dispatched French missionaries Father Pyenet and Assistant Father Kim Won-yeong.

title: Seobudu Myeongpum Hoejip geori
short_description: It is the original raw fish restaurant street with 18 raw fish restaurants located close together over a distance of about 150m and is a place where you can taste fresh Jeju raw fish all year round in one place.

title: Zero Station (Zero Point Trail)
short_description: Zero Station, located in Sanjicheon, is a café and a space for those who love the road and travel. It serves as a base camp for participants of the Zero Point Trail. The Zero Point Trail is a trekking program that begins at 0 meters above sea level on the Jeju coast and ascends to the summit of Hallasan Mountain (1,947 meters), without the aid of vehicles or motorized equipment.

title: Quiet walk
short_description: Goyosanchaek is a multi-cultural space operated by Jeju Honest Travel Co., Ltd., which explores Jeju's pristine nature and village travel experiences to create fair travel experiences that benefit tourists, residents, and destinations alike. Located in downtown Jeju City, Goyosanchaek offers a variety of cultural and artistic programs and rental spaces, as well as a book lounge and book stay space.

title: Sehwa Props Store
short_description: Sehwa Prop Shop, located near Sehwa Beach, is a prop shop with a variety of pretty items to see, including accessories, postcards, pencil cases, pouches, candles, air fresheners, griptoks, magnets, and more.

title: Hundertwasserpark
short_description: This is a natural artistic theme park that contains the art and architectural philosophy of Hundertwasser, one of the three greatest Austrian painters, environmental activist, and architectural therapist.

title: Pausa
short_description: This is a yoga cafe that offers drawing meditation and yoga.

title: Sunlight
short_description: A small workshop in Sinchon-ri, Jeju, that sells glass lighting, suncatchers, and various other items as a stained glass workshop and runs one-day classes.

title: Yoga Slow Garden

short_description: 西帰浦市中文観光団地のロッテホテル済州はプレミアム級としてよく知られているレクリエーション施設。こちらの別館1階に位置するVISPAは、1905年から名声を続けてきたスイスプレミアムアンチエイジングブランド「Valmont」とダラソセラピーのリーダー、フランスNo.1海洋性コスメブランド「ザルゴ（Thalgo）」を専門に使用する高品位スパといえる。専門教育を履修したセラピストの繊細な手触りで進行される多様なプログラムと顧客一人だけのためのプライベートサービスは、旅行や過度の疲労に疲れた体と心のバランスを探すようにしてくれる。

title: スイートホテルアロマ
short_description: スイーツホテルアロマは、寒い冬の旅行で疲れた足と体を暖かく癒すケアサービスを提供し、中文観光団地に位置して簡単に見つけることができる。中文観光団地内に位置するスイーツホテルアロマは、周辺にホテルロッテや新羅ホテル、ハイアットなどに近接している。それでも、特急ホテルで利用できるセラピーと比較して、最も安い利用料と長年の経験のノウハウに応じたケアサービスで、若いお客様に人気の高いアロマ専門ショップだ。

title: 済州ヨガ村
short_description: 済州市東朝川邑ワルルに位置する済州ヨガ村は、自分の余暇分析とタイプ別体験プログラムを通じて、自分だけの休みや遊び方を習得していく興味深い体験村だ。済州ヨガ村本部がある農村村「ワルリ」は世界重要農業遺産である済州畑塀の伝統性と多様性をよく保存し、済州市が推進する伝統畑塀を活用したヒーリング済州プラットフォーム構築事業の拠点村でもある。

title: マラド島ツアー
short_description: 最南端のマラド島ツアーは、住民が直接案内者兼解説士となり、無人島時代からこれまで続いたマラドの自然と文化、歴史、生活史を聞かせる島ツアープログラムだ。船着場ができる前、済州島で定期的な旅客船が行き来する以前の時代の物語、マラド島全体のこんにちはを祈願する割望堂の党文化、3ヶ月10日以上消えない火を避け、海を渡って逃げた蛇の話など、マラドに絡んだ物語と面白い島の物語をではなくはわかりにくいリアルなストーリーを聴くことができ、人気が多い。

title: ジルグランジセンター
short_description: 口座邑セファリ村住民477人が集まって作ったセファリ村協同組合が素敵な風光明媚なセファリビーチにジルグランセンターをオープンした。地上4階規模に建てられたジルグランジセンターは、1階はセファリ事務所が業務を見る空間と旅行者センターがあり、2階にはカフェや地区別店、3階は共有オフィス空間とセミナー室があり、大関しており、4階はセファ外街（宿泊施設）を備えている。

title: ハヨンオルレ
short_description: 西帰浦市の原都心の魅力をたっぷり感じられるトレッキングコース。済州観光公社と西帰浦市、済州オルレが共に開発・運営するこのハヨンオルレは、「ハヨン」という言葉から由来するように、西帰浦の原都心周辺の豊富な観光資源と6つの都心公園（コルメ生態公園、七十里詩公園、セソム公園、チャグリ公園、チョンモシ公園、ソンバン川）、3つの特化通り（イ・ジュンソプ通り、七十里飲食特化通り、アランジョウル通り）を融合させ、西帰浦の自然と人文、文化が融合した観光客と道民が多様な方法で楽しめる道に構成されている。

title: 新興里椿＆香りの道
short_description: ツバキシーズンには初冬から早春まで多くの人々が訪れるスポットだ。在来種椿、赤ちゃん椿、カーネーション椿など様々な椿が私たちを迎える。開花時期が椿ごとに異なるので、行くたびに別の椿に会うことができる。

title: 南原港（南原浦区）
short_description: オレギル5コースのスタート地点としてよく知られている南原浦区。ここは昔の砲口が内港にあるが、石で積んだ模様をそのまま大事にし、さらに魅力がある所だ。真夏の昼間は海水プール場で子供たちが飛び回る音でいっぱいだったが、今は距離置き施行で運営をしていない。夕方になると、砲口を囲んで釣りをする釣り人たちがくるのに、柄のイカなどが釣れるという。南原浦区は南原の町の中にあるため、南原のグルメ店が近くにあり、食事するのにも良い。

title: マフニーの森の道
short_description: 水泳アリの向かい側の探訪路入口からマフニオルム頂上までは、片道の長さが5.3kmの森道だ。合計10キロ少し超えているので、途中で休むときに飲む水やキンバプを安くして行くことをお勧めします。 10キロなら3時間～4時間程度かかる。森の道最初に入ると、水が少しある済州の岬ジャワルに会うことができる。

title: 柑橘類博物館ウォラボン遊歩道
short_description: 柑橘類の博物館には生耳鳴り道というウォラボンの遊歩道がよく飾られている。生が鳴る道で柑橘類博物館周辺を散策できるが、散歩コースはゆっくり歩くと1時間程度のコースでウォラボン頂上岩まで行くことができる。頂上岩に上がると、あの遠くに指貴島まで見える。パノラマの空間に面し、胸が広がる涼しい感じがするところだ。

title: 西中川探訪路
short_description: 落葉を踏む音が良く、西中川渓谷に沿って流れる水音が良いところだ。春には桃の木、夏には涼しい水、秋には紅葉が冬には雪景色が良いところだ。西中川沿いをゆっくり歩いてみよう。他の人は見つけられなかった秘境を見つけるかもしれません。

title: ウポトシネマギャラリーカフェ
short_description: 大韓民国の映画写真界を導いてきた優明率の写真家が故郷の済州に降りてきてオープンしたシネマギャラリーカフェ

title: キム・ハン美術館＆カフェ3206
short_description: 咸鏡北道が故郷の西洋画家キム・ハン（1928～2013）の遺作と遺品を展示している美術館とカフェ。

title: アルジェイ

title: 老衡スーパーマーケット
short_description: 少し幼稚で、どこか愉快で、最後には神秘的な感じがするスーパーマーケットの世界へ！

title: 永登割望神話公園
short_description: 永登割望神話公園は鬼徳浦区からビーチ沿いに玄武岩で作られた狭い石道に沿って約1kmほど続く。道を歩いて済州神話を調べる楽しみも感じてみよう。

title: ハンマ共信キム・マンイル記念館
short_description: 壬辰倭乱当時、戦争に使う馬500匹を献納しながら、国難克服に寄与したキム・マンイル（1550～1632）を称えるための空間として2021年8月に開かれた。

title: 済州オウリム柑橘類体験農場（済州オリム）
short_description: 西帰浦市城山邑にある単一規模で広い露地柑橘類狩り体験農場

title: 楽天九九村の椅子公園
short_description: 千の椅子がある楽天九九椅子公園はオレ13コースを通る場所に位置しており、人々の足がとどまる場所である。エレベーターのある展望台までオープンし、涼しい風景を鑑賞できるようになった。 9つの泉があり、9つの村と呼ばれる楽天里の椅子公園を紹介する。

title: ソヨンアリオルム/龍ワイオルム
short_description: 神霊的な山という意味の英子オルム。西側においてソヨンアリオルムとも呼ばれ、龍ワイオルムとも呼ばれるオルムだ。上がり、上にある2つの石と漢拏山の背景は海だけを見ても恍惚する

title: ウォラボンジンジ洞窟（安徳面）
short_description: 安徳面のウォラボンは、上がりの形がまるで月が浮かぶ姿のようだと付けられた上りだ。ダレの木がたくさん自生しており、ダレオルムとも呼ばれる。南側では拍手の基礎、北側には安徳渓谷に位置している。頂上を見下ろしてみると、ジンジ洞窟に会うことができる。ウォラボンには7つのジンジ洞窟がある。ジンジ洞窟を見てしばらく病気の歴史を振り返ってみる。

title: ジョンダルゴマンナンドルシェルター
short_description: 終達海岸道路を通ってハド海水浴場に到達すると、ごろごろ避難所に会うことができる。早いのが好きな人にはその姿を見せないところでもある。まさに知らずに行けば、ただ過ぎやすい隠れたスポットだ。

title: 高氏住宅

title: 済州中央大聖堂
short_description: 1899年、第8代朝鮮教区長ミュンテル司教がフランス宣教師ペネ(Pyenet)主任新婦とキム・ウォニョン補佐花嫁を派遣しながら設置したゴシック様式大聖堂で済州教区最初の本堂

title: 西埠頭刺身屋通り

title: ゼロステーション（ゼロポイントトレイル）
short_description: ゼロステーションは山地川に位置するカフェイザの道と旅行を愛する人々のための空間です。ここはゼロポイントトレイルの参加者のためのベースキャンプの役割をしている。ゼロポイントトレイルは、海抜0mの済州海岸から出発し、海抜1,947mの漢拏山の頂上まで車両、動力の力を借りず、ひたすら参加者の2足で頂上まで上がるトレッキングプログラムだ。

title: 高陽散策
short_description: 高陽散策は済州の清浄自然と村の旅行コンテンツを発掘し、観光客、住民、旅行先のすべてが幸せな公正旅行を作る(株)済州着旅行が運営する複合文化空間だ。済州市原都心に位置する高陽散策は、様々な文化芸術プログラムや戴冠のための空間から、北ラウンジと北ステイ空間を運営している。

short_description: “梵高花园”，在这里您可以亲眼目睹、亲耳聆听、亲手触摸伟大艺术家梵高的生前生活。

title: 宫大奥瑞姆（宫大阿克）
short_description: 山峰的形状像弓，山腰处有一条弓形带，因此被称为弓带岳。

title: 汉拿的气味
short_description: 柑橘体验中心

title: 济州宝露露&泰路主题公园（Pororo & Tayo Theme Park Jeju）
short_description:
一个可以见到深受孩子们喜爱的卡通人物“宝露露”和“泰路”的主题公园
室内和室外均设有各种游乐设施，即使雨天也可以尽情享受。

title: 济州艺术中心
short_description: 济州艺术中心于 2010 年 5 月开幕，是一个专业的表演厅，拥有济州岛最大的礼堂，设备齐全，能够完美地支持各种类型的表演。

title: 济州阳光农场
short_description: 一家柑橘农场，在济州岛世界自然遗产地巨文岳、拉姆萨尔湿地、冬柏洞山、咸德西峰海滩等著名景点附近，利用温暖的阳光和精心的照料种植有机柑橘。

title: 飞洋岛延坪里露营地
short_description: 位于牛岛（Udo Island）内的小岛比扬岛上的露营地

title: 济州未来教育研究院科学探索体验中心
short_description: 济州未来教育研究院科学探索体验中心位于山禄北路中心地带，可俯瞰汉拿山。沿着汉拿山公路行驶，很快就能到达科学探索体验中心。中心内设施丰富，定会让大人和孩子都流连忘返。

title: 梦幻乐园儿童图书馆
short_description: 昆巴堂儿童图书馆最初是总统访问济州岛期间的下榻之处。自1984年建成以来，曾接待过十一位总统，包括全斗焕、卢泰愚和金泳三。1996年解除安保措施后，这里也曾短暂地作为济州知事的官邸。2014年，该建筑归还济州岛居民，经过多次讨论，于2017年改建为昆巴堂儿童图书馆。

title: 德鲁库姆达牧场咖啡馆
short_description: Ranch Cafe Deurkumda 坐拥全景视野，提供丰富的活动，包括喂养动物、骑马、卡丁车和独特的自行车骑行。它位于 Beonyeong-ro Boulevard，交通便利，舒适的咖啡厅和体验中心巧妙地融合于同一空间。透过咖啡厅的观景窗，郁郁葱葱的田野尽收眼底。

title: 日出大地艺术中心
short_description: 伊尔楚大地艺术中心是一个专门体验靛蓝染色工艺的场所。这里的靛蓝染色体验之所以如此特别，是因为靛蓝植株本身就是人工栽培的。靛蓝植株在三月或四月播种，七月或八月收获。当植株长到60-70厘米高时，便会进行手工发酵，制成染料。靛蓝不仅拥有美丽的色彩，还具有强大的抗菌和杀菌功效，自古以来就被广泛用于珍贵衣物和文件的染色。天然染色虽然费时费力，但付出越多，染出的色彩就越浓郁、越深邃。

title: 西归浦农业技术中心济州农业生态中心
short_description: 位于西归浦中央山区的济州农业生态中心（隶属于西归浦农业技术中心）是您了解柑橘类水果所有问题的理想场所。其广阔的园区内设有济州柑橘推广中心、柑橘品种展览馆、柑橘森林步道和柑橘采摘体验中心。

title: 济州阿里郎 新灵魂
short_description: 作为 2018 年平昌冬奥会的官方邀请函，您可以欣赏精彩的济州阿里郎歌舞剧、精彩的跆拳道音乐剧《Dudream》以及韩国舞蹈。

title: Aewol潜水学校
short_description: Aewol水肺潜水体验，从初级认证到高级课程的培训

title: 金冲浪济州
short_description: 在济州岛最美的海滩——中文珞达海滩学习冲浪！

title: 活跃公园
short_description: 我们通过世界知名的攀爬游乐场品牌“Clip & Climb”中心、儿童咖啡馆和休闲车，提供积极的娱乐活动。

title: 济州岛工坊Nokkome
short_description: 一个可以体验各种手工工艺品的空间

title: 济州海洋休闲公园
short_description: 这是一个海上休闲公园，您可以在Yeraepogu的宁静与休闲中享受各种海上运动。

title: 帕帕比勒
short_description: “帕帕维尔”是一个以石头为主题的旅游景点，在一个广阔的空间里展示了济州岛地下玄武岩的各种形态。

title: 格瓦内姆萨露营地
short_description: 汉拿山观音寺露营地位于济州市北部的阿拉洞，是您在济州市中心附近享受露营乐趣的好去处。

title: 穆尔莫疗愈农场
short_description: Mulmoe Healing Farm 位于济州市爱月邑苏珊里，其名称来源于当地名称苏珊（水、山）。

title: 楚伊达森度假村
short_description: Chuidaseon Resort Tea & Meditation 是一家以休息为首要目标的冥想度假村。

title: 奇幻森林 Gotjawal Damang 足浴
short_description: 大芒足浴位于“环山森林哥扎瓦尔公园”内，在那里您可以欣赏到济州岛的原始森林风光。

title: 植物园主题公园（夜市街和LED公园）——计划于2026年3月1日重新开放。
short_description: 植物园主题公园松林中的夜市与其他夜市截然不同。LED灯光照亮了整片森林，美食餐车、跳蚤市场和拍照区充满了迷人的氛围。

title: 服装鬼镇
short_description: 奥特吉玛主题小镇是一个可以让你体验在乌伊格维里干净纯净的柏树和榉树林以及绿色草地上骑马乐趣的地方。

title: 新风里田野墙路
short_description: 城山邑新丰里是一个半农半渔村，意为“以建设一个崭新繁荣的村庄为目标”，被称为“母婴房（父母）宴村”，至今仍保留着传统的文化和生活方式。

title: 北村里 4.3 吉尔
short_description: 北村里是位于朝村面东端的海滨村庄。

title: 慕良自行车道（环城自行车道第三段）
short_description: 从海格瑞姆村公园延伸至松岳山的这条绝佳自行车道分为三段，沿途您可以邂逅并欣赏济州岛的各种美景，包括济州岛小型渔港中最热门的板浦港；以海上风车为海岸公路增添美景的新昌风车海岸公路；济州岛代表性日落景点水月峰和茶归岛；您可以享受与人交流乐趣的大井油市场；以及您可以享受宁静休闲时光的松岳山。

title: 济州高山里遗址
short_description: 我们的国家！最早、最古老、最受喜爱的新石器时代遗址：济州岛高山里！

title: 济州潜水艇（国际领袖俱乐部）
short_description: 国际领袖俱乐部，一个海洋运动主题公园，您可以在这里尽情享受济州岛碧绿的海水！

title: 野餐伴侣
short_description: 一家专门出租野餐用具和销售野餐用品的商店

title: 巴鲁特温泉
short_description: 人们常常在日出时分驻足许愿，或重燃对未来的希望。相反，凝视着绯红的夕阳，则能让人放下日常生活的种种压力，沉浸于这美妙的氛围之中。济州市峨月邑新岩里新岩港前的沿海公路，是欣赏日落的绝佳地点之一。这里，一处舒适的休憩之所，为疲惫的人们提供了一处静谧的休憩之所。巴鲁特水疗中心（Barut Spa）位于偶来度假村内，以济州方言中“海”一词“巴鲁特”（Barut）命名，俯瞰沿海公路和远处的小树林之外的峨月海。水疗中心氛围温馨舒适。

title: 缝隙农场
short_description: 在蔚蓝的天空下，我将一条手工靛蓝手帕挂在橘园里。我的朋友则晾晒着一个柿汁小袋。这里有一个地方，你可以体验在传统橘园里采摘橘子，并通过传统的柿汁染色工艺制作属于自己的独特作品。这里是位于济州岛西归浦市南原邑维美里的“Ieumsae”教育农场，一个运用济州岛天然染色技艺的天然染色体验中心。

title: 工作坊：Haru_and_a_half
short_description: 在月井里，有一个可以体验各种手工艺品的空间。

title: 乐天酒店之声水疗中心
short_description: 位于西归浦中文旅游区的济州乐天酒店以其高端度假设施而闻名。酒店附楼一层设有V Spa，是一家高端水疗中心，专营瑞士顶级抗衰老品牌Valmont（始于1905年）和法国海洋护肤品品牌Thalgo（海洋疗法领导者）。水疗中心提供丰富多样的护理项目和个性化服务，由经验丰富的专业理疗师以精湛的手法为您打造舒适体验。这些服务以及为每位顾客量身定制的个性化护理，有助于舒缓旅途疲劳或工作压力，恢复身心平衡。

title: 甜蜜酒店香气
short_description: Sweet Hotel Aroma 提供舒缓护理服务，帮助您在寒冷的冬季旅行后放松疲惫的双腿和身体。Sweet Hotel Aroma 位于中文旅游区内，交通便利。它毗邻乐天酒店、新罗酒店和凯悦酒店等知名酒店。尽管如此，与豪华酒店的护理服务相比，Sweet Hotel Aroma 的价格却更加亲民。凭借多年的经验积累，其优质的护理服务也使其成为深受年轻顾客欢迎的芳香疗法店。

title: 济州休闲村
short_description: 济州休闲村位于济州市东部的箕川邑瓦赫尔，是一个引人入胜的体验式村落。游客可以通过休闲分析和个性化体验项目，探索属于自己的独特休憩和玩乐方式。济州休闲村总部所在的瓦赫尔里村，保留了济州巴特坝的传统和多样性。济州巴特坝是世界重要农业文化遗产系统（GIAHS）之一，也是济州市利用传统巴特坝打造疗愈平台项目的枢纽。

title: 马拉多岛之旅
short_description: 马罗岛之旅，位于济州岛最南端，由当地居民担任导游和讲解员，带领游客领略岛屿从无人居住时期到如今的自然美景、文化、历史和生活方式。行程亮点包括由居民讲述的民间故事和引人入胜的岛屿传说，例如码头建成之前、济州岛客轮往来之前的种种故事，祈求全岛平安的哈尔曼堂祭祀仪式，以及一条蛇为躲避持续燃烧三个多月十天的大火而横渡大海的传说。这些故事广受欢迎，让游客有机会聆听只有当地人才懂的真实故事。

title: 吉尔格伦吉中心
short_description: 由古瓦邑塞瓦里村477位村民组成的塞瓦村合作社，在风景秀丽的塞瓦里海滩开设了吉尔格伦吉中心。这座四层建筑的一楼设有塞瓦里办公室和游客信息中心；二楼设有咖啡馆和当地商店；三楼设有可供出租的共享办公空间和研讨室；四楼为塞瓦巴克格奥里（住宿区）。

title: 金泽华美术馆
short_description: 一座艺术博物馆，在这里可以看到画家金泽和的生平和作品。

title: 斧头石羊驼牧场
short_description: 位于涯月森林中的济州唯一一家羊驼牧场

title: 史努比花园
short_description: 史努比花园是一个特别的地方，您可以与个性鲜明的花生漫画角色见面，通过与他们的互动获得共鸣与治愈的信息。

title: 晓星朋友（晓星HEYYO牧场）
short_description: 晓星HEYYO牧场位于晓星岳附近，是一个可以见到羊驼、马、驴、山羊和羊的牧场。可以和可爱的动物朋友们一起制造愉快的回忆。

title: ARTE 美术馆
short_description: 韩国最大沉浸式媒体艺术美术馆

title: 激光生存 M
short_description: 室内突发袭击游戏，让你在现实中也能享受刺激！

title: 济州岛之友
short_description: 西归浦市滑板车和电动自行车租赁

title: 济州岛海洋事业部
short_description: 如果您想体验各种休闲活动……请前往云津港

title: 尤兰潜水中心
short_description: 西归浦潜水体验、旅游和教育专家

title: 济州安全体验中心
short_description: 在这个特殊的体验空间里，现役消防员具备应对各种灾害的技能，他们将提供安全培训，您可以学习如何独立行动，并花些时间认真思考安全的重要性。

title: M1971游艇之旅
short_description: 与济州岛海豚一起乘游艇游览

title: 戈波伊特潜水中心
short_description: Gopoit 潜水中心是一家专业的潜水培训中心，通过基于 PADI 协会的系统培训体系，追求安全和乐趣。

title: 日落海岸 1014
short_description: 骑济州电动自行车体验水月峰地质步道

title: 西归浦夏荣奥勒
short_description: 西归浦市的下横偶来小径为游客提供了一条步行路线，让他们能够充分体验市中心的魅力。这条小径由济州旅游发展局、西归浦市政府和济州偶来共同开发运营，顾名思义，它将西归浦市中心周边丰富的旅游资源与六个城市公园（岩梅生态公园、七十里城市公园、西岛公园、札古里公园、正模城市公园和松板川）和三条特色街道（李正燮街、七十里美食街和阿郎街）巧妙地结合在一起。这条小径为游客和当地居民提供了丰富多彩的体验，完美融合了西归浦的自然风光、文化底蕴和人文风情。

title: 新兴里山茶树和杜松树路
short_description: 从初冬到初春，山茶花盛开的季节吸引了众多游客。各种各样的山茶花竞相绽放，包括本土山茶花、幼苗山茶花和康乃馨山茶花。每种山茶花的花期各不相同，因此每次来访都能欣赏到不同的品种。

title: 南原港（南原港）
short_description: 南原港是著名的偶来小径5号路线的起点。这座古老的内港至今仍保留着石砌建筑的风貌，更添魅力。盛夏时节，这里常常回荡着孩子们在海水池中嬉戏的欢声笑语，但由于社交隔离措施，目前海水池已关闭。傍晚时分，垂钓者蜂拥而至，据说能钓到墨鱼和其他鱼类。南原港位于南原市中心，地理位置优越，周边遍布众多市内一流餐厅，是理想的用餐地点。

title: 马赫尼森林小径
short_description: 从穆林加里对面的步道入口到玛尼奥雷姆山顶，单程森林小径长5.3公里。全程略超过10公里，因此我们建议您携带水和紫菜包饭，以便沿途补充能量。10公里的徒步行程大约需要3到4个小时。在森林小径的起点，您会遇到济州岛的戈特扎瓦尔，这是一片水量较少的浅滩。

title: 柑橘博物馆 Wollabong Trail - Saengisori-gil
short_description: 柑橘博物馆内有一条维护良好的步行道，名为“生吉索里路”（Saengisori-gil），环绕着博物馆蜿蜒而行。悠闲地走完这条步道大约需要一个小时，最终到达卧佛峰（Wollabong）的顶峰。从山顶可以远眺至地归岛（Jigwido）。开阔的空间令人心旷神怡，精神焕发。

title: 瑞正川小径
short_description: 这里落叶沙沙作响，西正川潺潺流水声悦耳动听。春天，樱花烂漫；夏天，溪水清凉；秋天，红叶似火；冬天，白雪皑皑。不妨沿着西正川悠闲漫步，或许会发现一处鲜为人知的宝地。

title: Upoto 电影院画廊咖啡馆
short_description: 韩国电影摄影界的领军人物、摄影师禹明烈回到家乡济州岛后，开设了一家电影院画廊咖啡馆。

title: 金汉美术馆和咖啡馆 3206
short_description: 一家美术馆兼咖啡馆，展出来自咸镜北道的西式画家金汉（1928-2013）的作品和遗物。

title: RJ
short_description: 您好，这里是RJ，济州岛乡村体验的开发商和运营商。

title: 老衡超市
short_description: 让我们走进一个略显幼稚，却又愉快且神秘的超市世界

title: 永登奶奶神话公园
short_description: 永登婆娑神话公园沿着一条狭窄的玄武岩石道，从济州港沿海岸线延伸约1公里。漫步于此，您可以了解济州岛的神话传说。

title: 金万日纪念馆
short_description: 该纪念馆于 2021 年 8 月开放，旨在纪念金万日（1550-1632 年），他在壬辰倭乱期间捐赠了 500 匹马用于战争，为克服国家危机做出了贡献。

title: 济州岛柑橘体验农场（Jeju Oklim）
short_description: 位于西归浦市城山邑的一家规模较小、视野开阔的柑橘采摘体验农场。

title: 洛川阿霍普古特村椅子公园

title: Hamdeok Madang

title: Ohyeon Bulbaek Jeju Dongmun Market Main Branch
